globalRules: The linked block page owns the canonical statement of course doctrine; a resource begins where that statement ends.
Teach tool-agnostic mechanisms. Link to the block page for stack-specific controls, commands, versions, model names, and product behavior.

The live owning HTML page identified by the catalog canonical path wins when any source conflicts with a current course fact; scope canonicalOwner records the source that owns detailed doctrine or exact template wording.
Learner-facing prose contains no production rationale, scope commentary, drafting history, reviewer conversation, or claims about how the handout was made.
Examples are fresh and do not reveal answer keys, facilitator material, or mission-corpus answers.
No P5 resource, figure, caption, metadata field, link label, or alt text may identify, count, characterize, or hint which intake items are poisoned.
A similarity report is a review aid, not a semantic verdict; one cross-module reviewer adjudicates conceptual duplication after all module reviews.

portfolioCollisionRules.rule: P1-3 owns product-level supersession and retraction policy in the generated brief. P4-2 owns note-level epistemic status fields in the vault. Cross-link without restating the other layer.
P1-2 tests the behavior of the answer-making machine. P3-4 tests evidence support for one disputed claim during adjudication.
The block page owns the adjudication fork. P3-2 owns only the adjudicator-as-instrument layer: blinding, anchoring, and first-output advantage.
The block page owns the concrete OpenCode last-match case. P5-5 compares resolvers and uses predict-before-test drills across first-match, last-match, deny-overrides, and glob shadowing.
The block page owns the failure-layer model. P8-4 is a cost-ordered cookbook of minimal decisive probes plus worked misattributions.
PW-1 is a workstation-as-harness map and never repeats install steps; the install checklist remains canonical.
